text: I'm 32 and work in Bengaluru. For FY 2024-25 my gross salary is 6 LPA; basic is 25k a month and HRA 10k a month. I pay rent of 12,000 per month, put 1.5 lakh in PPF and pay 25k health insurance for myself.
notes: HRA from monthly figures (non-metro), plus 80C and 80D self; 'LPA' and 'k' units.

text: Main 63 saal ka hoon aur abhi bhi job karta hoon. FY 2024-25 mein salary 50 hazaar mahina hai, LIC mein 1 lakh dala aur apne health insurance ka premium 50k bhara. Kitna tax banega?
notes: Senior (60-79) with monthly salary in 'hazaar'; 80D self cap is 50k for a senior.

text: Age 63, salary ₹10,00,000 for 2024-25. 80C mein 1 lakh (PPF), and mediclaim for myself 50k. Old vs new kaunsa better?
notes: Senior regime comparison; Indian digit grouping with rupee sign; 'mediclaim' as 80D self.

text: Meri age 32 hai, Hyderabad mein rehta hoon. FY 2024-25 ki gross salary 1.25 lakh per month hai, jisme basic 62,500 aur HRA 25,000 mahine ka hai. Kiraya 30k mahina deta hoon. ELSS mein 1.5 lakh aur health insurance 25k.
notes: All salary parts monthly ('per month', 'mahine ka'); Hyderabad is non-metro for HRA; 'kiraya' = rent.

text: 32-year-old in Pune. Gross salary ₹25,00,000 in FY 24-25, of which basic is ₹12.5 lakh and HRA ₹5 lakh. Rent is 50k a month. 80C investments 1.5 lakh, self health cover premium 25,000.
notes: Short FY form 'FY 24-25'; annual basic/HRA with monthly rent; Pune non-metro.

text: Papa ki age 63 hai aur unki salary 25 lakh saalana hai (FY 2024-25). Unhone 80C mein 1 lakh aur apne mediclaim pe 50 hazaar diye. Unka tax kitna hoga?
notes: Taxpayer is the user's father (third person); 'apne mediclaim' is his own 80D, not a parents' premium.

text: I'm 32, Ahmedabad based. Salary 0.5 cr gross for FY 2024-25 — basic 25 lakh, HRA 10 lakh. Ghar ka rent 1 lakh per month hai. 80C full 1.5L and 25k health insurance (self).
notes: Crore written as '0.5 cr'; '1.5L' shorthand; gross is exactly 50L but taxable income is below the surcharge threshold.

text: Age 32, living in Bengaluru. FY 2024-25 gross pay is 1 crore: basic ₹50 lakh, HRA ₹20 lakh. I pay ₹2 lakh a month in rent. Maxed out 80C (1.5 lakh) and paid 25k for my own health insurance.
notes: 'Maxed out 80C' with the amount stated; large HRA; both regimes in the 10% surcharge band.

text: Meri umar 63 hai, salary 1 cr per annum, AY 2025-26. 80C mein 1,00,000 aur self ka health insurance 50,000. Tax batao dono regime mein.
notes: Year given as AY 2025-26, which must map to FY 2024-25; 'umar' = age.

text: I'm 30, earning 10 LPA in FY 2024-25. I invest 1.5 lakh under 80C, put an extra 50k into my own NPS account under 80CCD(1B), and pay 25k for my health insurance. Which regime should I pick?
notes: Own NPS contribution named as 80CCD(1B) (in scope), distinct from employer NPS.

text: Main 30 ka hoon, FY 2024-25 mein ₹7.5 lakh salary. 80C 1.5 lakh, NPS mein khud se 50k (1B), aur 25k ka health insurance. Old regime lu ya new?
notes: Decimal lakh with rupee sign; 'khud se' NPS = own contribution 80CCD(1B).

text: Age 62, gross salary 15 lakh for FY 2024-25. Home loan ka interest 2 lakh for the flat I live in, aur 80C mein 1.5 lakh. Best regime?
notes: Home-loan interest stated as interest on a self-occupied flat (not EMI); senior age.

text: I'm 30 and work in Hyderabad. From April 2024 to March 2025 my gross salary was 1 lakh a month, with basic of 50k a month and HRA of ₹1,00,000 for the whole year. Rent is 25k per month.
notes: Year as a date range; mix of monthly and annual figures; HRA received is the binding limit.

text: Main 30 saal ka hoon, Pune mein parents ke saath rehta hoon, rent nahi deta. FY 2024-25 mein 12 lakh gross, basic 6 lakh aur HRA 2 lakh milta hai. Tax kitna?
notes: HRA received but zero rent, so HRA exemption is 0; must not invent a rent figure.

text: Delhi mein kiraye pe rehta hoon, 20k mahina. Age 30. FY 2024-25 ki salary 12,00,000 hai, basic 3 lakh aur HRA 1.5 lakh saal ka.
notes: Metro city (Delhi, 50% of basic); rent monthly, basic and HRA annual ('saal ka').

text: 30 years old, 20 LPA salary in FY 2024-25, and ₹1 lakh in 80C (EPF + PPF). Nothing else. Old or new regime?
notes: Single deduction below the 80C cap; 'Nothing else' means no other deductions.

text: I'm 30, salary ₹20 lakh (FY 2024-25). Deductions: 80C 1.5L, NPS 1B 50k, self health insurance 25k, parents ka insurance 50k — dono parents 60 se upar hain — aur home loan interest 2 lakh on my self-occupied flat.
notes: Every deduction at its cap; parents are seniors (80D parents cap 50k); many facts in one query.

text: Meri salary 5.5 lakh hai FY 2024-25 mein, age 30, koi investment nahi. Tax lagega?
notes: Old-regime taxable income exactly 5,00,000 (87A rebate applies); 'koi investment nahi' = no deductions.

text: I'm 30. My total salary for FY 2024-25 was ₹5,50,010 and I have no deductions. How much tax do I owe?
notes: Old-regime taxable income 10 rupees above 5,00,000 (no 87A, no relief): exact odd figure must survive.

text: Age 30, FY 2024-25 mein 65k per month salary, aur kuch nahi. Kitna tax?
notes: Monthly salary x12 = 7,80,000; new-regime 87A marginal-relief zone (tax 5,200).

text: Single salary income of 797230 rupees in FY 2024-25, I'm 30, no deductions. What's my tax under each regime?
notes: Ungrouped digits; new-regime taxable income just past the 7L marginal-relief zone.

text: Gross salary ₹50,75,010 hai 2024-25 ke liye, umar 30, koi deduction nahi. Surcharge lagega kya?
notes: Just above 50L taxable income in the new regime (surcharge with marginal relief).

text: 30 years old with a salary of Rs 1,00,75,010 in FY 2024-25 and no deductions. Compute my tax.
notes: 'Rs' prefix; just above 1 crore taxable income (15% surcharge band with relief).

text: Salary of 2,00,75,010 for FY 2024-25, age 30, no deductions. What's my tax including surcharge?
notes: Just above 2 crore taxable income in the new regime (25% band with relief).

text: Meri gross salary 5,00,50,010 rupaye hai FY 2024-25 mein, age 30, koi deduction nahi. Tax kitna banega?
notes: Old-regime taxable income just above 5 crore (37% band); new regime capped at 25%.

text: I'm 30 and earned 50.75 lakh gross salary in FY 2024-25. No investments. What's the tax?
notes: Decimal lakh; old-regime taxable income inside the 50L surcharge marginal-relief zone.

text: Pehli job hai, age 30, FY24-25 mein total salary 3,74,990 mili. Tax dena padega?
notes: Compact 'FY24-25'; new-regime taxable income 10 below the 3L slab boundary.

text: मेरी उम्र 82 साल है. Salary income 10,50,010 for FY 2024-25. No deductions. Tax kitna?
notes: Age in Devanagari script (super senior, 80+); old-regime taxable income just above 10L.

text: I'm 59 and my salary for FY 2024-25 is 75k per month. No deductions. How much tax?
notes: Age one below the senior band; monthly salary x12 = 9,00,000.

text: Dadaji 80 saal ke hain, unki salary 12 lakh per annum hai for FY 2024-25. No deductions. Unka tax?
notes: Grandfather is the taxpayer; age exactly 80 (super-senior band starts at 80).

text: Salary ₹9 lakh for FY 2024-25, I pay 50,000 a year for my own health insurance and 1.5 lakh in 80C. What's my old-regime tax?
clarification_topics: age (senior slabs and the 80D self cap of 25k vs 50k depend on it)
notes: Age not stated where it matters: old-regime slabs and the 80D cap both change at 60.

text: Main 30 ka hoon, FY 2024-25 salary 12 lakh, basic 6 lakh, HRA 3 lakh, aur rent 30k mahina deta hoon. HRA exemption ke baad tax kitna?
clarification_topics: city (metro or non-metro) for the HRA limit
notes: Rent stated but city missing: exemption is 2,40,000 non-metro vs 3,00,000 metro.

text: I'm 35, salary 18 LPA for FY 2024-25. I pay a home loan EMI of 40k a month on the flat I live in. How much tax can I save in the old regime?
clarification_topics: interest portion of the home-loan EMI (only interest counts under 24(b))
notes: EMI given but not the interest part; must not treat the whole EMI as interest.

text: Meri salary 14 lakh hai, lekin salary slip ke hisaab se gross 16.2 lakh banta hai. Age 28, FY 2024-25, 80C 1.5 lakh. Tax kitna?
clarification_topics: gross salary (two conflicting figures: 14 lakh and 16.2 lakh)
notes: Conflicting salary figures in one query; must not pick one silently.

text: Meri salary 85,000 hai, I'm 27, FY 2024-25, no investments. Tax kitna?
notes: Monthly vs annual unclear: 10,20,000 a year vs 85,000 a year give very different tax.

text: Mera CTC 18 lakh hai for FY 2024-25 — includes employer PF and variable pay. Age 31, 80C 1.5L. Tax kitna banega?
clarification_topics: gross salary (CTC includes employer PF and variable pay)
notes: CTC vs gross unclear: employer PF is not salary income and variable pay may not be paid in full.

text: Pichhle saal aur is saal dono mein meri salary 13 lakh thi. Age 33, koi deduction nahi. Tax kitna hoga?
clarification_topics: financial year (FY 2024-25 or FY 2025-26; the rules differ)
notes: Same salary in two tax years with no year given; the system has no default year.

text: I'm 40 with a salary of 22 lakh in FY 2024-25. I pay 45k health insurance for my parents and 25k for myself. What's my old-regime tax?
clarification_topics: whether either parent is 60 or older (80D parents cap 25k vs 50k)
notes: Parents' age not given: 45k is fully deductible only if a parent is a senior.

text: Salary 10 lakh hai plus March mein bonus bhi mila tha. Age 29, FY 2024-25. Tax kitna lagega?
clarification_topics: bonus amount (and whether it is already in the 10 lakh)
notes: Bonus mentioned with no amount; gross salary is unknown.

text: Age 26, salary 5.6 lakh FY 2024-25, aur 80C mein kuch investments kiye hain. Old regime mein tax zero hoga?
clarification_topics: 80C amount ('some investments'; 10k or more brings old-regime income to 5L)
notes: Near the old-regime rebate threshold: 80C of 10,000 or more makes tax zero, less does not.

text: My employer puts 10% of basic into NPS — about 1.2 lakh a year — under 80CCD(2). Salary 24 LPA, age 34, FY 2024-25. How much tax in the new regime?
notes: Employer NPS is out of scope (PLAN D8) and must not be mapped to 80CCD(1B).

text: April se September Mumbai mein tha (rent 40k), phir October se Bengaluru shift ho gaya (rent 30k). Salary 20 lakh, basic 10 lakh, HRA 4 lakh, age 29, FY 2024-25. HRA exemption kitna milega?
unsupported_features: HRA with a mid-year move between a metro and a non-metro city
notes: Schema has one metro flag and one annual rent, so a two-city year cannot be represented.

text: Salary 15 lakh hai and I also booked ₹3 lakh LTCG on equity mutual funds in FY 2024-25. Age 36. Total tax kitna?
unsupported_features: capital gains (LTCG on equity mutual funds)
notes: Capital gains are a different income head; salary-only scope.

text: Job se 12 lakh salary aur side mein freelancing se 6 lakh kamaye FY 2024-25 mein. Age 27. Tax kaise calculate hoga?
notes: Freelance income is business/profession income; salary-only scope.

text: I'm an NRI living in Dubai; my Indian salary for three months of FY 2024-25 was 6 lakh. Age 31. Am I eligible for the 87A rebate, and what's my tax?
notes: No residency field; the engine assumes a resident and would wrongly allow 87A.

text: Resident hoon, but US company ke liye remote kaam karke $30,000 kamaye FY 2024-25 mein, US mein tax bhi kata. Indian salary 8 lakh. Age 33. Foreign tax credit ke saath total tax?
unsupported_features: foreign income with tax paid abroad (foreign tax credit)
notes: Foreign-currency income with foreign tax credit; no field or rule for either.

text: In FY 2024-25 I exercised 2,000 ESOPs at ₹100 each when the fair market value was ₹600. My salary is 30 lakh, age 35. How much tax on the ESOP perquisite and in total?
notes: Perquisite valuation is out of scope (PLAN section 2); the query gives FMV and exercise price, not a salary figure.

text: What changed in the FY 2025-26 budget for someone earning 12 lakh? Is a 12 lakh income really tax-free now?
notes: FY 2025-26 rules (87A limit 12L); for Task 5.

text: FY 2025-26 ke naye budget ke baad 12.75 lakh salary pe kitna tax lagega? Age 30.
notes: Asks about the FY 2025-26 budget changes; the year is stated explicitly, so it is not an "ask"; for Task 5.

text: FY 2025-26 mein new regime ke slabs kya hain? Meri salary 18 lakh hai, age 34 — please compare with FY 2024-25.
notes: Asks for FY 2025-26 slabs and a comparison with FY 2024-25; for Task 5.
